thread:
Maria: FYI I dropped a draft Grafana board with the runtime/infra signals we promised. Need quick alignment on alert thresholds and PD routing before I flip this to prod. Main panels: runtime_p95_latency_ms, kv_cache_hit_rate, model_qps_per_gpu, error_rate_5m. Dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood.local/d/rt-infra/draft

Sam: Reviewing now. Quick Q: what SLO should we encode for p95 initially (for the burn-rate calc)?

Maria: Proposal (org-level, we can split per-model later): p95 <= 280ms, error_rate_5m < 0.6%, kv_cache_hit_rate >= 65%. Putting that as a starting point for discussion.

Drew: 280ms is aggressive for long-sequence or non-quantized variants. Strong vote for per-route/model baselines. For paging I prefer burn-rate style alerts. Example critical rule I'd like to start from:

```
expr: slo_burn_rate{service="runtime",slo="p95"} > 1.8
for: 15m
labels: { severity: "critical" }
```

Tiago: Also we need rollout protection. During canaries we see transient p95 blips. Options: add a `rolling_update_active` metric check or a boolean `deployment_in_progress` label to mute pages while true, or add an annotation that skips paging during known canary windows. Example suppression: `unless deployment_in_progress == 1` or annotate `suppress_during_rollout=true`.

Anya: Routing proposal (draft): critical -> PagerDuty service `infra-pd` (primary infra rotation), high -> PagerDuty service `platform-ops` (engineering priority rotation), info -> post only to #platform-alerts channel. Escalation: 2 rotations (15m each) then notify SRE lead; auto-create internal ticket after 25m if unresolved. Feedback?

infra-bot: Created PagerDuty service `runtime-infra` (svc_ID: svc_9a2b). Webhook added to infra-alerts repo. Default routing set to `infra-pd` schedule.

Sam: For cache regressions we should use composite conditions to reduce noise. Suggestion:

```
expr: avg_over_time(kv_cache_hit_rate[10m]) < 0.55 and avg_over_time(model_qps_per_gpu[5m]) > 80
for: 5m
labels: { severity: "high" }
```

That way we only page when hit-rate drops under load. Also add a lower-severity metric-only alert for visibility.

Maria: Good call. I'll add both composite (page) and observation-only (low) rules. Plan: push Prometheus rules + Grafana JSON to infra-alerts repo and attach runbook URL. Owners for the change: Maria (dashboard + PR), Drew (threshold sign-off), Sam (PD config), Tiago (deployment suppression). :thumbsup:

Drew: Please ensure each alert has `runbook_url`, `likely_cause`, and `deployment_window` annotations. Runbooks should call out quick mitigation steps (e.g., failover to pooled GPUs, rollback model variant) and a checklist for correlation (recent deploy, autoscaler events, KV cache evictions).

oncall-bot: Sent test page to `infra-pd` schedule (test only). Routing confirmed to `infra-pd`  no escalation.

Maria: I'll open the PR this afternoon. If nobody objects, can we sync for 30m tomorrow at 11:00am PT to finalize PD routing and per-model thresholds?

Sam: Ack, I'll attend.

Tiago: One more: include a `suppression_window` label in alerts so the console can hide pages during scheduled maintenance windows. Also we should mark rules that are rollout-sensitive so that the UI can surface them to oncall.

Anya: Agree. Also want auto-ticketing to include the dashboard link and top 3 correlated metrics in the ticket body.

Maria: Noted. Opening PR: infra-alerts#712 (coming shortly). Will paste link once created.

tags: governance:alerts, followup:alert-pr
